gigaam.scope: Russian training and primary benchmark scope; English run retained as diagnostic
gigaam.longAudio: acoustic segmentation over 25 seconds, without reference text

medasr.scope: English medical dictation; Russian run retained as diagnostic
medasr.decoder: greedy CTC, no external language model

nemotron.scope: English and Russian are transcription-ready locales
nemotron.mode: documented offline Transformers path, explicit locale; this does not measure live streaming latency

canary.scope: English and Russian included in 25 ASR languages
canary.mode: documented Transformers transcription, explicit source language, no translation

timingLimitations: Native server candidates run on Mac CPU or Metal, not GPU VM; speed comparisons between engines are not controlled hardware comparisons.
WhisperKit time includes the production repeat check.
All audio is synthetic TTS, with paired deterministic noise except the clean-only natural-reading supplement.
Intended spoken scripts are WER references and have not been human verified against every audio file.

WhisperKit primary run preserves 168 Debug measurements and continues remaining audio in Release-Development for genuine App Attest publication between clips. Native decoding and repeat-check calls are unchanged; runtime is not a single-build benchmark.
applicationPathNotes: Current SFSpeechRecognizer controller and file adapter do not populate confidenceSpans. Replayed empty spans therefore match the current app; confidence-gated fields will require review.
SpeechAnalyzer confidence spans and WhisperKit decoder/recheck spans are measured in the actual native transcription run.
Server ASR candidates have no production DSpeechEngine or calibrated automatic application policy; their fields are applied only by simulated confirmation.
Server-generation schema rejection is a measured failure and is never retried until a successful model response. Transport failures stop the batch for operational recovery.
Server replay preserves the exact corrected text used for generation; it does not apply the lexicon a second time.
